topic: Lidar data processing and release timeline
summary_markdown:
The discussion focused on the status of Lidar data processing. One participant estimated a potential release date, ranging from an optimistic timeline (1.5 days) to a more realistic one (Thursday evening). The immediate technical challenge noted was ensuring accurate implementation across all features (zones, previous day's data, and impression writing).

A key logistical question regarding data submission was raised: whether data could be written starting the next day and processed later on the server. This request was declined by [p1], who stated that they are currently focused on a different area of development.
[p1] also noted difficulties in determining how to utilize the collected coordinates, suggesting this remains an unresolved issue.
decisions: The release timeline for Lidar data is estimated for Thursday evening at the latest.
